footer:
One question — how the sheet splits into pages. v1.029 says a page per class; the class switch (and the grading sheet) work in testing groups — classes that test at the same time (v0.193).
A · Recommended: a page per class (as decided). + each family finds their child's class on its own page; it can go up by that class's door. − more pages — a class with one student still gets a page.
B · A page per testing group (each class has its own heading inside). + fewer pages; matches the grading sheet. − two classes share a page, so it can't be split up by class.
